newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon foreign debt rises $44 mln in November.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon foreign debt rises $44 mln in November.

text.p: Lebanon's foreign debt rose $43.6 million in November to $1,702.3 million, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Tuesday.
The foreign debt stood at nearly $1,304.6 million in December 1995.
Net total public debt rose 292.5 billion Lebanese pounds in November to 15,604.3 billion from 15,311.8 billion in October, the Bank said.
"The increase in debt was mainly due to the rise in net domestic debt which reached 12,957.3 billion pounds at end November," the Bank added.
